payload.description:
As a dispatcher I pull work only from Kanbus: type chore, label spot, status open. I never write a sidecar queue file.

Feature: Kanbus queue
  Scenario: sidecar queue is not the source of truth
    Given a Kanbus project with one open spot chore
    When Spotticus lists eligible work
    Then that chore is the only candidate
    And no queue.json is consulted
payload.title: Open Kanbus chores labeled spot are the only backlog
